author: Marc Cousin
name: autostyle
description: Automatically applies a chosen darktable style to images whose EXIF metadata matches a configured tag value, using exiftool to read the tags.
description-extensive: This tool automatically applies one of your saved looks to photos as soon as it spots a particular setting recorded in the image's metadata, for example a camera's dynamic range mode. You tell it which metadata value to watch for and which style to apply, and it does the rest at import time or on demand via a shortcut. It relies on the free program exiftool to read even unusual camera tags.
